element_preconditions.reason: The machine encodes only two preconditions (user_active_prev_epoch, user_inactive_current_epoch) and drops the report's root-cause precondition that getUserUtilizationInEpoch uses <= instead of <, which is the stated cause of the identical epoch values and zero delta. The direction is right but a material condition is omitted.

element_required_property.reason: The report's required property is that the engaged user receives 100% of eligible rewards rather than the 25% floor. The machine encodes only received_rewards > (floor_numerator/floor_denominator)*eligible_rewards, i.e. merely exceeding the 25% floor, which is weaker than the stated 100% entitlement.

element_bad_outcome.reason: The machine's impact i_floor_penalty captures the report's bad outcome: every engaged user is permanently penalized to the 25% floor instead of receiving 100% of eligible rewards.

formula_preconditions.reason: The formula asserts user_active_prev_epoch and user_inactive_current_epoch as true, matching two report preconditions, but omits the <= vs < comparison condition that the report identifies as necessary for the bug to manifest.

formula_required_property.reason: The relation obligation only requires received_rewards to exceed the 25% floor fraction of eligible_rewards, whereas the report requires the user to receive 100% of eligible rewards; the 100% target is not encoded.

formula_bad_outcome.reason: The impact_ids reference i_floor_penalty, which faithfully encodes the report's bad outcome of permanent penalization to the 25% floor.
